sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 126.53 per unit (po:4500014428-10, po:4500014358-10, po:4500014313-10).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As to the index change and price history and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the energy index and the contractual notice period, and as a family business that values our long-standing relationship, we acknowledge your points.

In exchange for the 14-day payment terms you proposed, we are prepared to reduce our price to €133.80 per unit. We have kept the effective date of 1 November 2026, as this revised price already incorporates a significant concession to compensate for the shorter notice period. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

For our current offer, we propose a price of €133.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the volume change data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified your updated demand forecast; solid data is always appreciated, and we value the increased volume for our foundry. In response to this positive development, we are prepared to reduce our price to a price of €130.20 per unit. We accept your proposed package, maintaining the 14-day payment terms and the 1 November 2026 effective date. Our current Angebot is a price of €130.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

decisions.tactician: E0 is the only selectable option, since every alternative has an unknown supplier trade value. It pairs the faster payment the supplier asked for with today's price, so it meets the liquidity need it stated. The arguments chosen are the contract notice breach, the fall in energy prices that rebuts its stale spreadsheet, and our order history at the current price. I left out should-cost because it sits above today's price and could anchor the supplier upward. I also left out the forecast volume rise, which would add to its leverage.

decisions.tactician: E0 is the only selectable option; every other term mix has an unknown supplier trade value. It keeps the 14-day payment the supplier values and moves the price toward our health level. The supplier is open and conceding steadily, so countering beats accepting €133.80 now. Its own 14-day trade sets the cost-of-money anchor. Our should-cost figure (a1) and its weak delivery record (a2) both support a lower price without leaking our position. I left out the forecast increase (a3) because higher demand gives it leverage.
